ns2:course.label: Introduction to Anthropology
ns2:course.description: Anthropology was first envisioned as a holistic discipline, combining insights from the study of human anatomy and evolution, from research on material remains of human settlements and from the analysis of social interaction in language and other cultural practices. Following this tradition, this course explores the questions about where humans came from, how societies live and communicate, and why human cultural groups are both similar to each other and yet unique.
